import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
den=np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2)
def f3(p): a,b,w,c=p; return a*t+b*np.sin(w*t)/P+c*np.log(1+t)**2/P
best=None
for i in range(40):
    p0=[rng.normal(),rng.normal()*2,abs(rng.normal())+0.1,rng.normal()]
    r=least_squares(lambda p: f3(p)-dP_dt,p0)
    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
print(best.x, np.sum(best.fun**2)/den)
res=dP_dt-f3(best.x)
for name,v in [('t',t),('P',P)]:
    o=np.argsort(v); bins=np.array_split(o,8)
    print(name,[ (round(v[b].mean(),2), round(res[b].mean(),3), round(res[b].std(),3)) for b in bins])
